name: mk-skills
description: Skills and mods for Claude Code from the mk-skills collection

plugins.name: mk-boss
plugins.description: Orchestrator mode: the session's model plans and delegates work down a ladder of cheaper subagent models, spot-checks the results, and can consult a stronger model upward

plugins.name: mk-prompt
plugins.description: Turns rambling or dictated text into one short, well-structured prompt to review before sending

plugins.name: mk-progress
plugins.description: MK Progress: a purple task progress bar above the prompt in the Cache style (10 emoji cells, only the tip of a working bar blinks) and a side pane with one live card per subagent (green/yellow/red bars)
